text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Smart Falcon became the strongest top Umadol.
Her popularity was truly tremendous—"

text_block_list.name: Falco's Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Huuuh?! No matter how you look at it,
pop songs suit Falco way better, don't they?!

text_block_list.name: Falco's Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Nice try, poser! Her true essence is an untainted soul.
A cool beauty style that expresses both strength and grace is the best!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: With the increase in passionate fans, conflicts arising from differences in interpretation began to occur...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, hey, stop it~!
Don't fight over Falco!"

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
"Falco!?
Smart Falcon-san!?"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: You know, Falco is really happy that everyone cares about her so much, but...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Still, everyone interprets umadols differently! Everyone should be free to cheer in their own way!

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
"Still, this guy doesn't understand anything..."
No, you're the one who—!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
...I understand.
There are just some things you can't compromise on, huh.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Then—
throw all those feelings at Falco!

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —And so, the next day.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"And that's why!
Falco's ready to run~☆"

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: Eeeeh~~?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Having obtained sudden permission to open up the academy, we gathered many fans beyond just the ones who were arguing, but...

text_block_list.name: Fan C
text_block_list.text:
I heard we're holding an event, but...
do we just run?

text_block_list.name: Fan D
text_block_list.text:
Are they not going to sing?
I was hoping to watch the concert, too.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Alright, alright.
That's enough chit-chat!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: "Everyone☆ Don't take your eyes off Falco when she's running☆"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Ready, start☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Yaaaaah☆

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, Smart Falcon began running the course all by herself. Before long, to the fans who had initially seemed bewildered—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A strange turn of events began to unfold.

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Huh... Somehow, coming from Falco's running—
I can hear music?!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
"Is this... 'UNLIMITED IMPACT'!?
I can feel the beauty and strength of an absolute champion...!"

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
That's not all! Amidst the pop vibes, an overwhelming, fresh joy...
"Make debut!" flows straight into my heart...!

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: —I mean, Falco is just the absolute best at everything, isn't she...!

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
WOOOOOOOOOOOOOAAAH!!!!
Falco, you're the best everrrr!!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Everyone☆
Thank you for cheering me on!!"

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: Falcooo!!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Aha☆ That's great.
Everyone really felt your passion, Falco.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Falco is right at the center
of everyone's hearts.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Your Falco, that person's Falco...
Everyone's different, but everyone's Falco!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"It's okay, Falco won't let any of you down!
After all—I'm the ultimate Umadol☆"

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: Falco...!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Alright, everyone!
Let's keep going with the call-and-response, here we go~♪

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
"WOOOOOOOO!!
L-O-V-E!
LOVE-KYUN FALCOOOO!!!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Smart Falcon, uniting the hearts of her fans with her running alone—
she was, without a doubt, a top Umadol.
